query: For a 56‑year‑old female with diabetes and acute HF, among female inpatients ages 51–61: report percent on insulin vs oral agents in first 48h vs final 24h, and continued/initiated/discontinued counts.
final_sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.drug_type = 'Insulin' AND h.admittime <= p.starttime AND p.starttime <= h.dischtime THEN p.subject_id END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.drug_type = 'Oral' AND h.admittime <= p.starttime AND p.starttime <= h.dischtime THEN p.subject_id END), 0) AS ratio FROM patients p JOIN prescriptions pr ON p.subject_id = pr.subject_id JOIN icustays h ON p.subject_id = h.subject_id WHERE p.gender = 'Female' AND p.anchor_age = 56 AND h.intime <= p.starttime AND p.starttime <= h.outtime AND h.los <= 48 AND h.hadm_id IN (SELECT hadm_id FROM admissions WHERE gender = 'Female' AND anchor_age BETWEEN 51 AND 61 AND admission_type = 'ACUTE HF') AND (pr.orderid, pr.linkorderid) IN (SELECT orderid, linkorderid FROM inputevents WHERE continueinnextdept = 1 OR ordercategoryname = 'Initiated' OR ordercategoryname = 'Discontinued');
